summary: Phase 10 Turn 2 tablet master-detail split layouts verified end-to-end for both Shipments and Invoices tabs, plus mobile list-only fallback and direct /shipment/[id] and /invoice/[id] routes. Auto-login worked (session persisted), Overview loaded with Kishan Sir dashboard. On tablet (1024x768): Shipments shows LEFT list (search + filter chips All/Pending/In Transit/Warehouse/Delivered + first row auto-selected with green border) and RIGHT detail (PENDING pill, Bangkok←Chennai route, Financials, Timeline, Parties, Linked invoice). Clicking AURA-IT-002 correctly updated RIGHT to Kolkata→Bangkok IN TRANSIT with partial timeline and different carrier. Search + filter (Delivered) both worked and auto-selected first visible row. '+ New' button visible and clicking fires the Alert. Invoices tablet split shows LEFT list (filter chips All/Draft/Sent/Paid/Cancelled) and RIGHT detail (PAID pill, INV-AURA-PEN-001, Bill To → Lalit, Items table Description/Qty/Rate/Amount, Subtotal, GRAND TOTAL, Linked shipment card, Notes, Meta, green 'Share invoice · Save as PDF' button). Mobile viewport (390x844) correctly shows list-only for both tabs (Financials/Bill To/GRAND TOTAL counts all 0). /shipment/[id] and /invoice/[id] mobile routes both load the extracted body components with back chevron in header. OPSI orb + sidebar (LogiOp / FY selector / tabs / SHIPMENT STATS / JARVIS AURA / Alerts) all visible on tablet. No red screens, no page errors, no regression on Overview.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="box-only"` on View. RN 0.79+ warns: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shipments.tsx:289

Console repeatedly warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Present in multiple screens (shipments/invoices newBtn, primaryBtn, GlassCard, etc.). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shipments.tsx:357-361, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/invoices.tsx:363-367, /app/frontend/src/lib/invoice-detail-view.tsx:464-468

action_items: (Minor / non-blocking) Migrate `pointerEvents="box-only"` on ShipmentRow's inner View to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-only' }}` to silence RN deprecation warning.

(Minor / non-blocking) Replace `shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius` with the unified `boxShadow` CSS string (or wrap behind Platform.select) across shipments/invoices new/primary buttons and shared GlassCard to remove the app-wide RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: shipment-detail-view.tsx triggers two side-fetches (invoices list + parties list) on every id change; on tablet this now runs each time the user picks a different shipment. Acceptable but consider caching /api/parties + /api/invoices at parent level to avoid redundant network on every selection (perf, not correctness).
invoice-detail-view.tsx exports an unused `useInvoiceShare` hook that returns null — dead code, safe to remove.

Both split-view parents (shipments/invoices) mount the ScrollView-based DetailView inside a fixed right pane; React state resets when `id` changes and load() re-runs — this is correctly handled by the effect that clears state on id change. Verified no stale content leaks between selections.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded shipments (AURA-PEN-001, AURA-IT-001/002, AURA-DEL-001/002) and invoices (INV-AURA-PEN-001, AURA-INV-001).
context_for_next_testing_agent: TABLET_WIDTH = 900px. Use 1024x768 for split-layout tests and 390x844 for mobile list-only. Auto-login works via persisted expo-secure-store token. Filter chip row scrolls horizontally in 380px-wide left pane; 'Delivered' may be off-screen but still clickable via text selector. Alerts (Alert.alert) render as native window.confirm/alert on web — attach page.on('dialog', ...) before clicking + New.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works as spec'd.
